claim: Amazon Currency Converter for Sellers automatically converts sales proceeds so sellers receive funds in 20+ currencies.
evidence: Automatically convert and receive your funds in 20+ currencies with Amazon Currency Converter for Sellers.

claim: The converter covers 19 Amazon stores and 20+ payout currencies.
evidence: Convert and transfer funds for 19 Amazon stores and 20+ payout currencies.

claim: Converter pricing is volume-based, set by total cross-currency net proceeds during the past 12 months.
evidence: Our volume-based pricing is based on your total cross-currency net proceeds during the past 12 months.

claim: The converter fee is 1.50% for cross-currency net proceeds under $500,000 (both the under-$100,000 and $100,000–$500,000 tiers).
The converter fee is 1.25% for $500,000–$1,000,000 in cross-currency net proceeds.
The converter fee is 1.00% for $1,000,000–$10,000,000 in cross-currency net proceeds.
The converter fee is 0.75% above $10 million in cross-currency net proceeds.
evidence: $10 million+ | 0.75%

claim: Sellers who receive funds in JPY pay a flat 2.0%.
evidence: Sellers who receive funds in JPY pay a flat rate of 2.0%.

claim: Sellers who receive funds in AED, CHF, MXN, KRW or TWD pay a flat 1.5% regardless of tier.
evidence: Sellers who receive funds in AED, CHF, MXN, KRW, and TWD pay a flat rate of 1.5% regardless of tier.

claim: Volume can be combined across stores for converter pricing as long as the seller's global accounts are linked.
evidence: Yes, as long as your global accounts are linked.

claim: The converter uses the exchange rate applied by Amazon's third-party service provider on the day the transfer to the bank account is initiated.
evidence: the exchange rate applied by our third-party service provider on the day the transfer to your bank account is initiated.

claim: Converted funds generally arrive in the local bank account in 1 to 5 business days.
evidence: Funds generally arrive in your local bank account in 1 to 5 business days.

claim: A local bank account is added in Seller Central via the gear icon, Account Info, Payment information, then Deposit methods.
evidence: by selecting the gear icon, then Account Info. Next, select Payment information, then Deposit methods.

claim: Volume-based converter pricing is not available in all stores and currencies.
evidence: Volume-based pricing is not available in all stores and currencies.

claim: Cross-currency net proceeds means total cross-currency net proceeds across all Amazon stores for the past 12 months.
evidence: Total cross-currency net proceeds across all Amazon stores for the past 12 months

claim: Seller Wallet lets sellers transfer funds to global bank accounts and convert USD into 20+ currencies.
evidence: Make transfers to your global bank accounts and quickly convert funds from USD to 20+ currencies

claim: To enroll in Seller Wallet, a seller should have a US store seller account in good account health; Amazon lists further eligibility requirements, including proof of business establishment in a supported country or region.
evidence: To be eligible to enroll, you should have a seller account in the US store that is in good account health.
verifier_note: Narrowed: source's next sentence adds proof of business establishment in a supported country/region; page sentence updated.

claim: A separate Seller Wallet EUR is available for Germany, France, Spain, Italy, the Netherlands, Ireland and Belgium.
evidence: A separate Seller Wallet EUR is available for Germany, France, Spain, Italy, the Netherlands, Ireland, and Belgium.

claim: Creating and keeping a Seller Wallet account is free, as are USD transfers to US bank accounts.
evidence: It's free to create a Seller Wallet account and keep the account active. It's also free to make USD transfers to US bank accounts

claim: Amazon says Seller Wallet exchange rates are close to mid-market rates.
evidence: The exchange rates applied to your transfers are close to the mid-market rates.

claim: Seller Wallet shows the actual exchange rate before every transfer.
evidence: View your actual exchange rate before every transfer.

claim: US sales proceeds appear in Seller Wallet within minutes of disbursement.
evidence: You will see your US sales proceeds in Amazon Seller Wallet within minutes of your disbursement.

claim: Seller Wallet transfers can take 1 to 5 business days.
evidence: Transfers can take 1 to 5 business days

claim: Seller Wallet supports recurring weekly, biweekly or monthly transfers.
evidence: Set up recurring weekly, biweekly, or monthly transfers to your global bank accounts

claim: Seller Wallet can use up to two US or global bank accounts.
evidence: You can use up to two US or global bank accounts with Seller Wallet.

claim: Amounts reported on a US tax return must be expressed in US dollars.
publisher: IRS — Foreign currency and currency exchange rates
evidence: You must express the amounts you report on your U.S. tax return in U.S. dollars.

claim: A taxpayer's functional currency is generally the US dollar unless required to use a foreign currency.
publisher: IRS — Foreign currency and currency exchange rates
evidence: Your functional currency generally is the U.S. dollar unless you are required to use the currency of a foreign country.

claim: With a US dollar functional currency, use the exchange rate prevailing when you receive, pay or accrue the item.
publisher: IRS — Foreign currency and currency exchange rates
evidence: Use the exchange rate prevailing when you receive, pay, or accrue the item.

claim: If there is more than one exchange rate, use the one that most properly reflects your income.
publisher: IRS — Foreign currency and currency exchange rates
evidence: If there is more than one exchange rate, use the one that most properly reflects your income.

claim: Exchange rates can generally be obtained from banks and US Embassies.
publisher: IRS — Foreign currency and currency exchange rates
evidence: You can generally get exchange rates from banks and U.S. Embassies.

claim: A financial event group's original total is in the currency of the marketplace where the transactions occurred.
publisher: Amazon — Selling Partner API model, Finances API v0
evidence: The total amount in the currency of the marketplace in which the transactions occurred.

claim: A financial event group's converted total is in the currency of the marketplace in which the funds were disbursed.
publisher: Amazon — Selling Partner API model, Finances API v0
evidence: The total amount in the currency of the marketplace in which the funds were disbursed.
